author.name: General Counsel Online, Inc. d/b/a LegalScout

description: LegalScout connects you with opted-in law firms and their AI associates. Search by practice area or firm name, then talk through intake in this chat—or open the firm’s associate page for voice and portal tools. Existing clients can sign in with their portal email to check matters, talk to their matter associate, add notes, and get portal links. Discovery and prospect intake work without signing in; matter tools require client authorization.
